# Ricard Santiago Raigada García

> PhD candidate in Computer Architecture at Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya
> (UPC), working in the Accelerators and Communications for HPC (AccelCom) group
> at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC). Research on runtimes, scheduling
> and resource management for hybrid HPC–quantum systems.

Canonical URL: https://raigada-garcia.dev/
ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0009-9684-4745
Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=n6cqJmIAAAAJ

## About

- Role: PhD candidate (2026 – present), UPC Computer Architecture doctoral programme.
- Affiliation: UPC · Barcelona Supercomputing Center (AccelCom group).
- Location: Barcelona, Spain.
- Advisors: Antonio J. Peña (thesis director), Sergio Iserte.
- Research keywords: hybrid HPC–quantum computing, quantum-centric
  supercomputing, quantum circuit cutting, job scheduling and resource
  management, runtime systems, distributed quantum circuit simulation.

## Publications

- [Enabling Dynamic Resource Scaling in Quantum Circuit Simulations](https://raigada-garcia.dev/papers/2610.39824.html):
  arXiv:2610.39824 (2026). With Íñigo Aréjula-Aísa, Sergio Iserte, Petter Sandås,
  Oliver Brown, James Richings, Antonio J. Peña. QuEST extended with dynamic
  management of resources so a single HPC job can resize between quantum
  circuits of different sizes; experiments on MareNostrum 5 show negligible
  reconfiguration overhead.
- [Communication-Aware Qubit Placement and Automatic Node-Count Allocation for Distributed State-Vector Simulation](https://raigada-garcia.dev/papers/2610.09659.html):
  arXiv:2610.09659 (2026). With Íñigo Aréjula-Aísa, Sergio Iserte, Petter Sandås,
  Antonio J. Peña. Communication-aware qubit-layout framework with automatic
  node-count selection; speedups above 2× on synthetic and QASMBench circuits.
- [Wave-Based Dispatch for Circuit Cutting in Hybrid HPC–Quantum Systems](https://raigada-garcia.dev/papers/2604.15279.html):
  arXiv:2604.15279 (2026), accepted in FCGS, October 2026. With Josep Jorba,
  Sergio Iserte. DQR, a runtime that treats circuit-cutting fragments as
  schedulable units; evaluated on CESGA Qmio with IBM Torino and classical
  simulators.
- Emergent Geometrodynamic Intelligence in Transformers (Zenodo, 2025):
  https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15772617
- Quantum Database Architecture for the Quantum Data Scientist (MSc thesis,
  UOC, 2025): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14810946
- Symmetries in Quantum Mechanics: from Klein-Gordon Equation to Higgs
  Mechanism (Zenodo, 2025): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14774610
- Optimizing Quantum Circuits for Efficient Execution on Superconducting
  Hardware: A Case Study of the Cuccaro Adder (UOC technical report, 2024):
  https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.24291.77608

Full BibTeX: https://raigada-garcia.dev/publications.bib
